findings.issue: The Receiver correction is Godot's FFT AudioEffectPitchShift, set from receiver_plan. Quality at 1/16x..16x is unmeasured. Receiver also clamps the time rate to 1/16..16, which sits uneasily with 'no compromises on the physics' (documented in comms_feed.json, so low-medium).
